coordinate_system: x right, y down; all full-canvas production layers share origin [0,0]
reference_state: Mac observation brief received; actual pixel transfer pending
scope: Original composition/layer plan only; no source layout copying, no new image assets or runtime implementation

render_contract.style: Detailed naturalistic square-pixel clusters, connected organic shape groups, stepped silhouettes, restrained hue ramps; calm broad atmosphere with selective foreground detail.
render_contract.light: Soft upper-left light, consistent cast-shadow direction toward lower-right.
render_contract.depth: Far planes lower contrast and cooler; nearby forms darker with selective restrained warm highlights.
render_contract.bird_focus: Keep a broad continuous open ground stage. No birds, feeders, baths, furniture, text or UI baked into these layers.

name: Compact marine-morning courtyard with a side-gate glimpse
regional_fit: Small exterior coastal urban courtyard in diffuse marine light. Managed containers and sparse cultivated accents remain irrigation-dependent.
original_design_choices: Small domestic enclosure with quiet pale pavers, an asymmetrical low wall return and a narrow gate glimpse at far right.
No pergola, panoramic coastline, ridge vista, lake, boat or center feature; this is distinct from the previous broad managed patio.
Soft marine gray-blue upper opening contrasts with restrained buff plaster and warm-gray ground.
Only a narrow near left vine edge and small corner containers frame the open ground; no dense foliage arch.

composition_regions.role: Broad low-contrast pale exterior sky opening.
Small depth cue, kept quiet enough not to dominate birds.
Continuous understated paver ground with gentle seams, no central clutter.
Narrow vine/support fragment, sparse and peripheral.

layers.contents: Pale marine cloud deck, restrained low rooftop silhouettes and soft side-street color glimpse. Lower half quiet underpaint to be covered.
Quiet buff stucco rear boundary and return, narrow far-right side gate, small-scale continuous pale pavers with mild cool seam shadows.
layers.integration_rule: Align untrimmed origin; check gate glimpse and boundary silhouette against distance base.

layers.contents: One narrow side vine/support at extreme left and two small low corner container accents. Generic cultivated foliage; no new botanical species identity claim.
layers.limitations: Rigid pots/supports and leaves not independently rigged; requested alpha does not establish semantic separation inside the layer.

seasonal_constraints: Marine cloud does not imply rainforest vegetation.
Container greenness depends on management separately from calendar.
Outdoor courtyard only; no indoor visiting-bird or rain/wind behavior assumed.
